tools.name: search_designs
tools.description: Search the InfySVG catalog of free SVG cut files by keyword. Returns matching designs with their page URLs. Send the user to the page for downloads — every page offers free SVG, PNG, DXF and PDF plus recolouring, no account needed.

tools.name: get_design
tools.description: Full details for one design by its page slug (e.g. "royal-crown-121000019").

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every category and seasonal collection with design counts and page URLs.

tools.name: get_licence
tools.description: The licence terms for every design on InfySVG, in one paragraph.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_designs, list_categories · Private data: search_designs · Public sink: search_designs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_designs, list_categories · Private data: search_designs · Public sink: search_designs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
